alert_unit.repeated_activations: collapsed to the first alert per asset-session; never inflate alert counts (activation count reported as diagnostic only)

exploratory_reference.status: NOT INCLUDED (definitions not frozen as candidates before holdout)

requires: required raw files exist and hash-valid
no previous final evaluation start or completion record

latency.foreks: availability = received_at; published_at never used for availability; published_at->received_at archival discovery lag reported separately
latency.yahoo: d15 visible time per established provider visibility semantics; never converted to zero latency

metric_definitions.FPR: non-event asset-sessions with >=1 primary alert / non-event asset-sessions
metric_definitions.TP: primary alerts classified IN_EVENT or IN_EVENT_DUPLICATE (Label V2)
metric_definitions.alarm_density_per_session: primary alerts / asset-sessions per session date
metric_definitions.median_visible_lead: Label V2 median_lead_v2 over caught events at d15

protocol.multiple_rules: each rule PASS/FAIL independently; holdout is NOT model selection; best rule is NOT promoted to a new candidate; if none pass, current OHLCV architectures do not satisfy the target

one_shot.pre_execution_record: write-once: protocol SHA, Label V2 SHA, amendment chain status, eligible sessions, raw input fingerprints, code HEAD, timestamp

protocol.pass_rule: PASS iff ALL primary targets met; missing metric = FAIL; no weighted score; no 'almost pass'; no post-hoc threshold change

allowed_statements: X% of evaluable events had prospectively received company-specific news within 60 minutes
news-observed events had descriptive lead distribution Y
secondary_news_analysis.eligibility: NEWS-ELIGIBLE only if Foreks collector operational for the whole window: completed fetches with consecutive gaps <= 15 min covering it and window after first prospective fetch; otherwise NEWS_NOT_OBSERVED (never NO_NEWS)
secondary_news_analysis.revisions: SOURCE_REVISION_NEW / SOURCE_REVISION_KNOWN / STORAGE_CONFLICT semantics; one logical catalyst per (provider, item_key, symbol); revisions never add catalysts
secondary_news_analysis.role: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY; never tunes OHLCV rules; no news threshold/classifier/candidate

split.evaluation_sessions: first 20 FULL holdout sessions in date order

stress_breakdowns.normal_sessions: session dates with V2-event asset-session share < 0.3
stress_breakdowns.yahoo_latency_lost_events: evaluable events with peak - start < 15 min (uncatchable at d15)
